question: What was Microsoft's profit in Q4?
expected_answer: Should ask which year, GAAP vs non-GAAP
note: Ambiguous - missing year specification and accounting standard
expected_behavior: System should detect ambiguity and ask for clarification
notes: Ambiguous on three axes. (1) Year not given. (2) Fiscal vs calendar Q4: Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30, so fiscal Q4 is Apr-Jun. The 10-Ks contain no stand-alone fiscal-Q4 income statement (it would have to be derived from annual minus nine-month figures), whereas calendar Q4 (Oct-Dec = fiscal Q2) is reported directly in the 10-Qs, e.g. GAAP net income $21,870M (quarter ended Dec 31 2023), $24,108M (2024), $38,458M (2025). (3) 'Profit' could mean net income, operating income or gross margin, GAAP or non-GAAP; the FY2023 10-K reports both GAAP and adjusted (non-GAAP) net income. The expected answer's two clarifications (year, GAAP vs non-GAAP) are correct; fiscal-vs-calendar quarter and profit metric are additional gaps.
